_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships free-agents (run-to-completion 0.6.8). DATA lives here; the free-agents-only COMMANDS live in .rtc/*.sh, extracted verbatim from the old ~/.claude/scripts/fa-ship.sh. Adding this file is config-only: no version bump, no release.
_comment_assets: The release tarball and the ONE installer name. The dual .command upload was dropped 2026-10-26: it was the same bytes under a legacy name (superseded since 0.29.3) and the deep links it existed for were judged unused, so a stale install-free-agents.command link now 404s — accepted deliberately. Version-free globs are deliberate: scripts/package-release.sh reads VERSION and wipes dist/ each run, so exactly one tarball exists when these resolve. A glob that matches nothing now FAILS the ship (rtc-ship.sh 0.6.6) rather than silently publishing without it.
_comment_tests: No test_cmd: the main suite is the pytest default, and the two extra venv gates run from .rtc/pre-flight.sh.
_comment_limiter_knobs: Limiter knobs for load-sensitive/critical tests (rate_limiter.py shipped 0.50.1; wired ON BY DEFAULT in tests/conftest.py _limiter_knobs_for_load_sensitive since 0.50.4): tests marked pytest.mark.load_sensitive automatically run with LA_LIMITER_RESERVE=0.2 (reserve 20% of the bucket for priority acquisitions; normal traffic stops at 80%) and LA_LIMITER_PRIORITY=1 (this process draws from the reserve), so they don't flake when a concurrent session fills the limiter. Manual/live use: LA_LIMITER_RESERVE=0.2 in the priority process's env, or `python3 bin/rate_limiter.py set-owner <session-id> --priority [--rpm-scale 0.2]` to throttle/prioritize one live session, `... owners` to list window holders, `... probe` for external occupancy of your bucket. Details: tests/test_loadscale.py LimiterKnobDefaultTests; bin/rate_limiter.py _reserve_frac/try_acquire.
